label: ⏳ Replace outliers
description: Replace values flagged in an `is_anomaly` (or boolean) column with a rolling-median estimate. Use this AFTER `anomaly_zscore` to clean a series before forecasting — otherwise outliers leak into the seasonal/trend decomposition and skew the forecast intervals.

flag.label: Outlier flag column (boolean)
flag.help: Typically the `is_anomaly` column from the anomaly_zscore step.

window.label: Median window (rows)
window.help: Number of nearby rows used to compute the replacement median. Smaller = more local; larger = smoother.

output_column.label: Output column name
output_column.help: Name for the cleaned column. Original value column is preserved.
